verdict.rationale: Highnote's 'Collaborative authorization' feature explicitly lets developers approve/decline transactions in real time via business logic, and webhooks/notifications are configurable per event with signing-key rotation. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of the specific network time budget or a developer-controlled timeout fallback behavior for collaborative authorization responses. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the authorization response time window and configurable/default fallback (approve/decline) when the endpoint doesn't respond in time.
